about: The Master Template's front end, word for word: the two openings (New, and Extension of Existing), the warranty lines, and when each line is printed. A line's 'when' names a condition below; a line with no 'when' is a template default. A 'who' condition holds only when the thing and the party are in the same sentence; with 'not_ownership', not when those words stand between them (the owner's network connection or the location the owner sets is not the owner furnishing the item). The headings are printed by the proposal writer from the mode (estimator.proposal.layout) and are kept here only so the two never drift apart. Every pattern is a regular expression, matched without regard to case. Edit the wording and the words here, never in code.

headings.new-system: Front End Web Enabled BMS System
headings.extend-existing: Seamlessly Tie in to the Existing {system} BMS

new-system.text: Furnish UPS – For workstation, server, network level control panel
Furnish Necessary Training on New Controls

extend-existing.text: Furnish Necessary Training on New Controls

about_keep: A line marked "keep" is one of AME's standard front-end lines. The whole-job front end prints every line above that holds; the lines the AI's plan adds fill it to 6 lines at most, except a line 'past_the_cap' names. "Furnish PC Workstation" is always printed, unless the documents give the workstation to the owner in the same sentence.

past_the_cap.about: A front-end line the AI's plan adds that the specification explicitly calls for goes in past the 6-line cap: its words match one of 'words' and the Spec overview found one of 'topics'. Regular expressions, ignoring case.

contradicts.about: A client note from the AI's plan that gives a front-end line's item to others (the owner, 'by others') contradicts the line. 'lines' names each line's item; 'given_away' finds a note giving it away. The one the documents support in the same sentence is kept: the line when the Spec overview calls for it, the note when a sentence of the Spec overview names the item and gives it to the owner or others; else the line. Regular expressions, ignoring case.

existing_systems.about: The BMS names read from the tie-in sentence, in this order, joined with ' / ' as the template writes 'Honeywell / Niagara N4'. When none is named the name is a bracketed fill-in and flagged. Fill-ins are in square brackets so they read as blanks to complete, never as internal words.

warranty.about: Printed when the Spec overview's services find a warranty with its length stated. {term} is that length ('one-year' in the template). The second line needs a maintenance or service contract extended past the warranty, with the extra years stated. extended_header names the standalone 'Qty (1) Extended Warranty' block written when the job calls for that extension (estimator.writing.front_end.extended_warranty_block).
warranty.heading: Warranty scope of work-
warranty.contract: a {term} preventative maintenance service contract covering all parts, materials, software, hardware, and all costs to provide software and hardware upgrades during the warranty period.
warranty.extension: extend the maintenance service contract and the warranty for {years} additional years following the warranty period.
